input: Get a quote for professional window cleaning

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The number of windows, floors, and whether interior/exterior or both are included directly determines complexity and price range.
Whether this is for a personal home, a rental property, or a business changes which type of service provider to contact.
The location (city/region) determines which local companies are available to contact.
A target budget helps filter out providers and sets expectations for how many quotes are worth seeking.
Knowing the preferred method of getting quotes (phone, online form, in-person estimate) shapes the immediate next action.
Knowing how many quotes the user wants to compare determines how much outreach effort is needed.
Any priority factors — such as eco-friendly products, insurance/certification, or speed of service — narrow down which providers to approach.

gold.taskTitle: Get a professional window cleaning quote
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to obtain a price quote from a professional window cleaning service.

questions.title: How many windows and floors does the property have?
questions.description: Understand the scale of the job — number of windows, storeys, and whether interior, exterior, or both sides need cleaning.

questions.title: Is this for a home, rental property, or business?
questions.description: Identify who the cleaning is for, as residential and commercial services are often quoted differently.

questions.title: What city or area is the property located in?
questions.description: Pinpoint the location so that local, available window cleaning companies can be identified.

questions.title: Do you have a budget or price range in mind?
questions.description: Establish any upper spending limit to help filter providers and set realistic expectations.

questions.title: How do you prefer to request the quote — phone, online, or in-person?
questions.description: Determine the contact method the user is most comfortable with to define the immediate next action.

questions.title: How many different companies do you want quotes from?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a single quote or multiple to compare, which affects how much outreach is required.

questions.title: Are there any must-have requirements for the cleaning company?
questions.description: Identify any non-negotiable preferences such as eco-friendly products, proof of insurance, specific certifications, or availability by a certain date.
